Subject: DPA redlines and SCCs for upcoming agreement

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the call yesterday. As we start finalizing the MSA and order form, legal has a few outstanding asks on the DPA side we need to resolve before procurement can push the PO through. See attached redline and the SCCs matrix. High level items: 

- Ther a) needs explicit confirmation of international transfer mechanisms for telemetry and logs and b) wants a transfer impact addendum for EU users.
- Role allocation: we want a clear controller/processor statement and a short exhibit listing subprocessor categories and locations.
- KMS and key ownership: confirm whether keys for private deployment are customer-managed and what evidence is available for hosted keys.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the redline loop and an estimate for sign off? We re looking at a target contract signature by 2027-07-02 to align with our procurement cycle.

Attachments: TheraHealth_DPA_redline_v1.docx, SCCs_territory_matrix.xlsx

Best,
Procurement Team
TheraHealth

Hi all,

Thanks for sending the redline. Quick acknowledgement and proposed mutual action plan below. Monica will drive evidence collection and Ben will cover order form carveouts and operational controls. I ll summarize internal owners and a realistic timeline so you have visibility into sign off.

Proposed next steps (short):
- Today: internal intake and triage. Monica to list required evidence items and known subprocessors.
- Mon Jun 21: internal technical note on KMS options and hosted key evidence.
- Tue Jun 22: redline pass from Redwood on DPA and SCCs matrix.
- Wed Jun 23: joint legal call to walk remaining exceptions.
- Fri Jun 25: target final redline for signature review to both legal teams.

From: Laura Chen <lchen@therahealth.com>

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines and SCCs for upcoming agreement

Hi Avery and team,

Thanks for the quick reply and proposed timeline. A few clarifications from Ther aHealth legal after our initial review of your internal runbook excerpt and the attached redline: 

- Transfer scope: we need an explicit transfer impact addendum limited to EU data subjects, describing where data may be processed, and the fallback transfer mechanism (SCCs) plus any supplementary measures. A general export control statement isn t sufficient for our privacy team.
- Roles: Ther aHealth expects a narrow controller statement for customer data and processor for model inference outputs. Please confirm whether Redwood will accept a processor exhibit that lists processor activities by feature (embeddings, logs, analytics).
- Subprocessors: provide a current list by service category and country. If some subprocessors are covered by regional partners, flag those explicitly.

Redline highlights attached. See comments on clauses 4.2, 7.1 and Annex B. Procurement has paused PO until we have either: (a) a signed DPA with the addendum or (b) an interim exception with documented compensating controls and an executive signoff from Redwood.

If you think an exception path is necessary, outline required controls and the executive approver at Redwood who can sign a temporary exception for up to 90 days.

Regards,
Laura Chen
Senior Counsel, Privacy
TheraHealth
Attachment: TheraHealth_DPA_redline_v1_comments.docx

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <lchen@therahealth.com>, TheraHealth Procurement <procurement@therahealth.com>

Laura, thanks for the clear direction. Action items and owners below; I ve included the interim exception template language so your team can see what an approval would look like.

Action items (owners):
- Monica Patel: compiled subprocessors list by category and country, and evidence pack for hosted key management and SOC attestation. Delivery: Tue Jun 22 EOD.
- Ben Carter: DPA redline pass focused on clause 4.2, proposed processor exhibit, and order form carveout language for telemetry. Delivery: Tue Jun 22 COB.
- Avery Johnson: internal exec exception routing. If an exception is needed, I will route to Head of Legal and VP Sales for a 90-day interim exception. Expect decision within 48 hours of formal exception request.

Interim exception (summary):
- Scope: temporary allowance for telemetry routing to US regions pending DPA addendum.
- Controls: data minimization, IP allowlisting, limited retention window, SOC 2 Type II evidence, encrypted transit and at-rest with provider keys.
- Approval: requires Head of Legal and VP Sales signoff.

Proposed next checkpoint: joint call Wed Jun 23 10:00 AM PT to walk redline and exception language. Please confirm if that time works and whether you prefer a dial-in or video link.

Thanks,
